nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: 100% local sovereign model execution across faster-whisper, WhisperDeepfakeMLPHead, and local vLLM Qwen2.5-3B. Zero data dispatched to external or offshore commercial AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic). Meta WhatsApp Cloud API configured with UAE Local Storage data-at-rest residency.

fr_3_3_webhook_ingress_sla.verification: FastAPI POST /webhook validates constant-time HMAC-SHA256 signature and enqueues payload to Redis high_priority_triage queue, emitting HTTP 200 acknowledgment in P95 <= 3.5ms and P99 <= 12.8ms, far surpassing the mandatory 500ms hard ceiling.

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_b_data_separation.verification: Class B citizen telephone numbers are cryptographically pseudonymized via keyed HMAC-SHA256 with 32-byte salt immediately upon ingestion. Raw phone strings are held in volatile variables purged via try...finally blocks. Only Class A threat indicators (phishing domains, malicious lures) are persisted to the database in plain text.

fr_1_1_unified_audio_triage.verification: Single forward pass Whisper encoder extracts 384-dimensional acoustic representations feeding both ASR transcription and WhisperDeepfakeMLPHead, executing in <180ms with weights_only=True PyTorch loading.

fr_1_4_conformal_calibration.verification: Non-parametric empirical calibration guarantees False Positive Rate <= 0.1% (alpha=0.001) over 3,000 genuine UAE voice samples, sanitizing NaN/Inf values and enforcing finite bounds.

protocol_11_air_gapped_zero_saas.verification: Next.js 15 Municipal SOC Dashboard executes 100% self-contained static assets without external CDN scripts, third-party JavaScript libraries, or external Google Fonts. Cryptographic Merkle/SHA-256 snapshotting is computed natively via window.crypto.subtle.digest.

audit_observations.title: Plaintext Master SOC Admin Passkey Hardcoded in Frontend Source, Default Config, and Committed to Git History
audit_observations.finding_description: The master administrative clearance passkey ('APPledbx@33#hinxtolnimda') is hardcoded directly as a TypeScript constant in frontend/src/lib/PortalModeContext.tsx (export const MASTER_SOC_KEY) and frontend/src/lib/api.ts (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYST_KEY || 'APPledbx@33#hinxtolnimda'). In Next.js client builds, this plaintext string is compiled directly into browser JavaScript bundles. Furthermore, in src/hares/core/config.py line 61, SOC_ADMIN_PASSWORD defaults to this exact passkey with no production validator preventing its use. In src/hares/api/deps.py, any client presenting this key via 'X-API-Key' or 'Authorization: Bearer' is granted full municipal analyst clearance. In PortalModeContext.tsx line 43, the condition 'password.trim() === expectedKey || password.trim() === MASTER_SOC_KEY' ensures that even if an administrator sets NEXT_PUBLIC_SOC_PASSWORD, the hardcoded fallback remains valid.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Remove MASTER_SOC_KEY constant entirely from frontend/src/lib/PortalModeContext.tsx and frontend/src/lib/api.ts. 2. Remove default value from SOC_ADMIN_PASSWORD in src/hares/core/config.py and add a strict @field_validator enforcing minimum 32 characters and rejecting default passkeys in production. 3. In PortalModeContext.tsx, authenticate against the backend via a dedicated /api/v1/auth/verify endpoint rather than performing client-side string comparisons. 4. Rotate the passkey immediately across all environments. 5. Scrub the credential from Git commit history using git-filter-repo or BFG Repo-Cleaner.

audit_observations.title: Meta WhatsApp Access Token Expiration & Permanent Token Configuration Discrepancy
audit_observations.finding_description: Live probing against the Meta Graph API (v21.0) revealed that WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN expired on Monday, 12-Oct-26 07:00:00 PDT with OAuthException Code 190, Subcode 463. While .env line 17 defines WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN_PERMAMENT with an active System User access token, src/hares/core/config.py only declares and binds WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN. Consequently, production workers and outbound notification dispatchers fail when communicating with Meta Cloud API endpoints.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Update .env so that WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN is assigned the active permanent System User token. 2. Enhance src/hares/core/config.py to optionally check WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN_PERMAMENT as a fallback if WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN is expired or absent. 3. Integrate automated token expiry checking into the /health/ready probe or a scheduled Celery heartbeat task.

audit_observations.title: Unauthenticated Remote Inference Exposure of vLLM SLM Container on Host Network
audit_observations.finding_description: In docker-compose.prod.yml lines 127-128, the hares-slm container publishes port '8001:8000' without specifying an interface binding, causing Docker to bind port 8001 to 0.0.0.0 (all host network interfaces). Furthermore, the vLLM container command does not configure the '--api-key' parameter. Any host or network attacker reachable on port 8001 can invoke the OpenAI-compatible v1/completions and v1/chat/completions endpoints directly, completely bypassing FastAPI input sanitization, XML boundary stripping, rate limiting, and NeMo guardrails.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Remove published port 8001:8000 from hares-slm in docker-compose.prod.yml, restricting access strictly to the internal bridge network (hares_internal). If host access is strictly required for local diagnostics, bind exclusively to loopback: '127.0.0.1:8001:8000'. 2. Configure '--api-key' in the vLLM container command using an internal secret loaded from .env.

audit_observations.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus Scrape and Metric Query Endpoint Published on 0.0.0.0:9090
audit_observations.finding_description: In docker-compose.prod.yml line 231, hares-prometheus publishes '9090:9090' to 0.0.0.0 without authentication. Prometheus web UI exposes raw metrics, scrape targets, internal service DNS names (api:8000), scrape intervals, and active operational labels to unauthenticated users on the network.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Bind Prometheus port exclusively to localhost ('127.0.0.1:9090:9090') or route it through an authenticating reverse proxy (e.g., Nginx with HTTP Basic Auth or OAuth2 Proxy). 2. Restrict Prometheus access to municipal SOC VPN/internal networks.

audit_observations.title: Unbounded Public Citizen Web Triage Ingestion Lacks Rate Limiting on POST /api/v1/triage/verify
audit_observations.finding_description: While the WhatsApp Webhook endpoint (POST /webhook) strictly enforces 5 queries/hour per citizen hash and threat feed APIs enforce 120 req/min per analyst, the public citizen web triage route POST /api/v1/triage/verify has no rate limiting middleware or token-bucket validation. An attacker can repeatedly submit audio payloads or multi-kilobyte text lures, exhausting GPU inference capacity on Whisper, AASIST, and Qwen2.5-3B.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Apply RedisTokenBucketRateLimiter to POST /api/v1/triage/verify, keyed by client IP address (or hashed X-Forwarded-For) with a limit of 10 requests per minute per IP. 2. Implement IP throttling or Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification on the web portal.

audit_observations.title: Plaintext Database and Redis Connection Strings in Version-Controlled Configuration & Scripts
audit_observations.finding_description: alembic.ini line 26 contains a committed plaintext connection string ('sqlalchemy.url = postgresql+psycopg2://hares_admin:secure_postgres_password_here@localhost:5432/hares_threat_db'). While env.py overrides this at runtime, the static file retains the credential. Furthermore, scripts/stage_cluster.py lines 227 and 290 hardcode 'secure_postgres_password_here' and 'secure_redis_password_here' rather than reading dynamically from Settings or os.environ.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Replace static connection string in alembic.ini with a dummy placeholder ('postgresql+psycopg2://hares_admin:REPLACE_IN_ENV@localhost:5432/hares_threat_db'). 2. Update scripts/stage_cluster.py to read DATABASE_URL_SYNC and REDIS_URL directly from get_settings().

audit_observations.title: Ephemeral STIX 2.1 CTI ECDSA Digital Signing Key Generated in Memory on Startup
audit_observations.finding_description: While Settings declares STIX_SIGNING_KEY_HEX, get_stix_signing_key() in src/hares/core/security.py ignores this setting and invokes ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1()) in volatile memory. If the application restarts or if multiple worker processes handle STIX signing and verification, public keys diverge, causing digital signatures on detached X-Hares-Bundle-Signature headers to fail verification across inter-agency municipal SOCs.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Update get_stix_signing_key() to parse STIX_SIGNING_KEY_HEX from Settings using ec.derive_private_key() or load from a secure PEM file path, falling back to ephemeral generation only in testing contexts.

audit_observations.title: Database Connection Exception Details Leaked via Public /health/ready Endpoint
audit_observations.finding_description: In src/hares/api/v1/health.py lines 42 and 63, exception handlers assign checks['database'] = f'error: {str(exc)}' and checks['redis'] = f'error: {str(exc)}'. When PostgreSQL or Redis encounters a connection or authentication failure, asyncpg exception strings can disclose internal database hostnames, usernames, port numbers, or network topology to unauthenticated callers.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Sanitize error messages in /health/ready to generic statuses (e.g., 'checks': {'database': 'connection_error', 'redis': 'connection_error'}) while logging detailed exception traces internally.

audit_observations.title: Missing FFmpeg Package in Runner Stage of Root Dockerfile
audit_observations.finding_description: The root Dockerfile runner stage installs only 'libpq5 curl', omitting 'ffmpeg'. When hares-worker-media runs inside Docker containers, shutil.which('ffmpeg') returns None, causing AudioPreprocessor to fall back to simulated acoustic downsampling rather than native FFmpeg Opus transcoding.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. Add 'ffmpeg' to the apt-get install list in the runner stage of Dockerfile.

audit_observations.title: FastAPI OpenAPI Swagger Documentation Exposed in Production
audit_observations.finding_description: FastAPI initializes without overriding docs_url, redoc_url, or openapi_url based on ENVIRONMENT. In production, /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json remain publicly accessible, exposing internal API structures, Pydantic schemas, and endpoints.
audit_observations.remediation: 1. In src/hares/main.py, pass docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None to FastAPI() when settings.ENVIRONMENT == 'production'.

audit_conclusion.summary: Project Hares demonstrates exceptional sovereign AI architecture, strict adherence to FR-4.1 Class A vs B privacy separation, robust cryptographic webhook validation, and a 100% passing test suite across 136 tests. However, the presence of the hardcoded master passkey ('APPledbx@33#hinxtolnimda') in frontend client code and Git history, coupled with the expired Meta access token, unauthenticated vLLM SLM container port exposure (8001:8000), and unauthenticated Prometheus metrics (9090:9090), necessitates immediate pre-launch remediation before municipal deployment.
